exclusions.delete_board: destroys a board and every card on it
exclusions.delete_column: cascade-deletes every card in the column
exclusions.next_assignment: runner-only pickup path; interactive sessions claim by move_card

inclusions.get_skill: the server instructions tell interactive agents to install the board's skills
inclusions.get_workspace_metrics: read-only reporting used by the standup workflow
inclusions.list_git_repos: read-only; boards are linked to repos
inclusions.list_skills: the server instructions tell interactive agents to install the board's skills

activate_catalog_skill.description:
Copy a catalog skill into the workspace library as published v1. Human
sessions only (runner keys 403). Idempotent.
activate_catalog_skill.title: Activate catalog skill

add_card_dependency.description: Declare that card_id depends on depends_on_card_id, gating scheduler pickup until the prerequisite satisfies its effective completion policy. Idempotent: re-adding returns the existing edge (200); cycles and self-deps are 422.

params.card_id: Dependent card UUID or id prefix.
params.depends_on_card_id: Prerequisite card UUID or id prefix.

add_card_dependency.title: Add card dependency

add_card_participant.description: Add a participant to a card. Idempotent: an existing row keeps its pipeline_role unless it was NULL, which is backfilled.

params.pipeline_role: Stage role for role-aware filters (planner, implementer, reviewer, ... or custom; max 64 chars).

add_card_participant.title: Add card participant

add_team_member.description:
Add a runner to a team with roles; idempotent, re-adding updates the roles.
orchestrator/reviewer/documentator are one runner per team; custom allows many.
add_team_member.title: Add team member

add_workspace_member.description: Add a user to a workspace, auto-provisioning them if needed. Idempotent: an existing member is returned unchanged and role is ignored; use update_workspace_member to change a role.

params.user_email: Email of the user to add.

add_workspace_member.title: Add workspace member

apply_loop_template_fixes.description:
Apply named fixes from a fit report, then return the fresh report.
Idempotent per fix (`skipped_already_satisfied`); unknown fix ids are 422
before anything applies; a frozen board 409s.
apply_loop_template_fixes.title: Apply loop template fixes

archive_loop_template.description:
Soft-archive a workspace template (archived=False restores). Archived
templates keep serving bound boards; there is no hard delete.
archive_loop_template.title: Archive loop template

bulk_create_cards.description: Create up to 50 cards on a board in one request. An invalid column_id, unknown git_repo_slug or unknown key rejects the whole batch (422).

params.cards: Each: column_id, title (required); description, card_type (task|issue|feature|bug), priority (none|low|medium|high|urgent), due_date (YYYY-MM-DD), status, labels, git_repo_slug. Nothing else.

bulk_create_cards.title: Bulk create cards

bulk_set_card_dependencies.description: Atomically replace a card's whole depends-on set in one call; use it to declare a DAG from the planner stage. The set is validated for cycles and tenancy before anything changes; on rejection existing edges stay.

params.depends_on_card_ids: Complete prerequisite list (UUIDs or id prefixes); empty clears the set.

bulk_set_card_dependencies.title: Bulk set card dependencies

cancel_execution.description:
Force a stuck 'running' execution to a terminal status, clearing the
agent_busy 409 guard that stalls the pipeline.
cancel_execution.title: Cancel execution

cancel_merge_queue_entry.description:
Cancel a wedged (conflict/failed) merge-queue entry for human triage
(admin/owner only); the card is eligible for next_assignment again.
cancel_merge_queue_entry.title: Cancel merge queue entry

create_agent.description: Create a runner identity; raw_api_key is returned exactly once.

params.allowed_workspaces: Workspace slugs the runner may see; must be non-empty.
params.name: Display name.

create_agent.title: Create agent

create_board.description:
Create a board, optionally with its structured definition in the same call.

Idempotent only when slug is given (an existing board with that slug is returned); without slug every call mints a new board. Definition fields upsert either way.

params.definition_content: Raw dict for other definition keys.
params.name: Display name.
params.skip_default_columns: Skip the default typed columns (To Do/In Progress/Blocked/Done).

create_board.title: Create board

create_card.description: Create a card in a column.

params.git_repo_slug: Target repo slug on multi-repo boards; omit for the primary repo.
params.title: Max 500 characters.

create_card.title: Create card

create_channel.description: Create a contact channel in a workspace.

params.contact_value: Address or identifier (email, phone number, URL).
params.name: Display name.

create_channel.title: Create channel

create_column.description: Create a column at the end of a board.

params.column_type: backlog|active|review|done|blocked; drives runner discovery and movement.
params.name: Display name.

create_column.title: Create column

create_git_repo.description: Link a git repo to a board.

params.name: Display name.
params.require_branch_protection: Runner arms branch protection at first clone (default True); False for human-owned repos.
params.slug: Per-card git_repo_slug selector on multi-repo boards; derived from name when omitted.

create_git_repo.title: Create git repo

create_loop_template.description:
Create a workspace loop template as an unpublished draft. Not
idempotent: a repeated slug is 409. Author large prompts in the UI or
REST; MCP has garbled multi-KB strings.
create_loop_template.title: Create loop template

create_note.description: Create a note in a workspace or board, optionally linked to a card.

params.card_id: Card to link; needs board_id and a card on this board (else 422; unknown or cross-workspace card 404).
params.content: Body as markdown (HTML, plain text or ProseMirror JSON also accepted).
params.kind: user_note (default) or a structural kind: plan, rework_brief, review_verdict, ...
params.pinned: Pin the note to the top.
params.title: Note title.

create_note.title: Create note

create_prompt_config.description:
Create a prompt config: a stage prompt override for matching runners,
applied on their next config refresh.
create_prompt_config.title: Create prompt config

create_resource.description: Create a file or folder resource. For uploads: get_upload_url, PUT the file, then pass its gcs_path here.
create_resource.title: Create resource

create_team.description: Create a team of runners in a workspace.

params.board_id: Board UUID to scope the team to.
params.name: Team name.

create_team.title: Create team

create_webhook.description: Create a webhook delivering workspace events to a URL, HMAC-SHA256 signed with the secret.

params.events: Event names; see ENUMS in the server instructions.

create_webhook.title: Create webhook

create_workspace.description: Create a workspace; the creator becomes owner. If the slug already exists and you are a member, nothing is created: the existing workspace comes back under `existing` plus an `error` string (a no-op, not a failure). Non-members get a 409 with no metadata.

params.name: Display name.
params.slug: URL slug; derived from name if omitted.

create_workspace.title: Create workspace

decide_approval.description: Approve or reject a pending approval request.
decide_approval.title: Decide approval

delete_board.description:
Permanently delete a board and everything scoped to it. IRREVERSIBLE — confirm the board_id first.

Cascades to columns, cards, notes, definition, git-repo bindings, resources; activity/execution history is kept but unlinked.
delete_board.title: Delete board

delete_column.description: Delete a column and all its cards permanently.
delete_column.title: Delete column

delete_git_repo.description: Unlink a git repo from a board.
delete_git_repo.title: Delete git repo

delete_prompt_config.description: Delete a prompt config; affected runners fall back to defaults.
delete_prompt_config.title: Delete prompt config

delete_workspace.description: PERMANENTLY delete a workspace and everything in it (boards, columns, cards, definitions, git-repo bindings, notes, resources, channels, memberships). No undo; confirm the slug with list_workspaces first. Needs admin/owner; an already-deleted workspace reports so instead of erroring.
delete_workspace.title: Delete workspace

duplicate_loop_template.description:
Fork a system or workspace template into a new workspace draft; how a
system template gets customized.

params.new_slug: Slug for the copy; omit to derive one.

duplicate_loop_template.title: Duplicate loop template

enable_toolsets.description:
Widen THIS session's server tool hand and request client refresh; notification delivery does not prove the client catalog updated.

Widen-only and idempotent: ids already loaded add nothing and send no
notification; `all` lifts the toolset layer. A runner allowlist is a
ceiling this never lifts — names it clips are reported under
allowlist_clipped. Returns loaded (ids, or ["all"]), added_tools/
added_count, enabled_tool_count and listing_bytes of this session's
tools/list, list_changed_sent, client_catalog_status (always unverified),
and restart_env (server startup environment preserving the current hand).

params.toolset_ids: Toolset ids to add: all, default, or any group or category id listed under get_server_info.toolsets.available.

enable_toolsets.title: Enable toolsets

enqueue_for_merge.description:
Re-queue a card's existing merge-queue entry after conflict consolidation;
idempotent, 404 if the card has no entry.
enqueue_for_merge.title: Enqueue for merge

enqueue_pr_for_merge.description:
Enqueue a card's green, self-reviewed PR for the server-side merge queue;
never run `gh pr merge` yourself.

The executor rebases and lands it once CI is green and the reconciler moves
the card to Done. Runner calls need the board loop's
loop_landing="merge_queue" (else error_code loop_landing_not_enabled).
Idempotent.

params.integration_branch: Target branch; defaults to the repo's integration, then default, branch.

enqueue_pr_for_merge.title: Enqueue pr for merge

export_loop_template.description:
Export a template as a portable `loop_template` envelope for
import_loop_template. System templates export too. `data.leak_findings`
carries lint hints as warnings; export always succeeds.
export_loop_template.title: Export loop template

export_pipeline_bundle.description: Export a portable bundle (pipeline_config, derived setup_contract, workspace-scoped prompt_configs) for import_pipeline_bundle on another workspace. Platform-default prompts are excluded; they re-seed on the target.
export_pipeline_bundle.title: Export pipeline bundle

freeze_board.description:
Freeze a board: every mutation returns 409 board_frozen and the scheduler stops handing out its cards until unfreeze_board.

Reads and telemetry (execution logging, approvals) stay open. Workspace admin/owner. Idempotent.
freeze_board.title: Freeze board

get_agent_budget_status.description: Check one runner's spend against its budget cap.
get_agent_budget_status.title: Get agent budget status

get_agent_config.description:
Get the runner identity linked to this API key (agent_id, allowed_workspaces,
allowed_actions); falls back to the user identity when no runner is linked.
get_agent_config.title: Get agent config

get_board.description: Get a board with its columns and their cards. On large boards pass summary_only or titles_only; summary_only wins when both are set.

params.summary_only: Per-column card counts + priority/status breakdowns, no cards.

get_board.title: Get board

get_board_health.description: Get a board's computed health: score (0-100), stale/overdue/unassigned cards, priority and column distribution, velocity. Use for triage and standup.
get_board_health.title: Get board health

get_board_loop.description: Read loop config: state, prompts, provider/model, tools, caps, disabled_reason, version and template (null for raw prompts). Unconfigured=404.
get_board_loop.title: Get board loop

get_board_loop_binding_raw.description:
Raw view of a board's template binding: template, version, rendered
slot values, drift — the authoring state behind get_board_loop, which is
the effective loop config. 404 `not_bound` when the board's prompts are raw.

params.include_diff: Also fetch the prompt diff and slot delta vs. the current version (skipped when `diff_available` is false).

get_board_loop_binding_raw.title: Get board loop binding raw

get_card.description: Get one card with full details (participants, markdown description).
get_card.title: Get card

get_card_dependency_status.description: Report whether a card is unblocked: satisfied (every prerequisite meets its effective completion policy), total_prerequisites, blocking (undone prerequisites with title/status/column_type) and blocks_count.
get_card_dependency_status.title: Get card dependency status

get_card_verdict.description: Fetch the latest review verdict on a card (decision and reasoning) before reworking it. 404 when the card has no verdict yet.
get_card_verdict.title: Get card verdict

get_completion_policy.description: Read effective completion policy, inheritance and capabilities.
get_completion_policy.title: Get completion policy

get_completion_status.description: Read current candidate, exact source/merge SHAs and public attempt history.
get_completion_status.title: Get completion status

get_definition.description: Get a board's definition: scope plus structured content.
get_definition.title: Get definition

get_download_url.description: Get a signed download URL (valid 1 hour) for a resource's file; errors if it has no file.
get_download_url.title: Get download url

get_loop_template.description: Read a template: full=profile/prompts/slots/rails/tools; profile=identity and board/execution/spend/outcome history (archived included); preview=read-only render with board autofill/rails; fit=board checks (ok|missing|warn), evidence, fix_id for apply_loop_template_fixes, and autofill; lint=repo facts to move into slots (hints only, draft). Rehearse published text before binding. Avoid full prompt previews inside running loops.

params.board_id: Board UUID/slug; required for fit, optional for preview.
params.draft: True=draft, false=published. Default: false for full, true for rehearsal.
params.include_prompts: preview: false omits large prompt bodies, keeping findings/slots/rails/tools.
params.slot_values: fit/preview: proposed slots; missing values use autofill, then defaults.
params.version: fit/preview: exact published version; requires draft=false.

get_loop_template.title: Get loop template

get_note.description: Read one note; format="markdown" returns readable, token-cheap content.

params.note_id: Note UUID or id prefix (resolved within the same scope).

get_note.title: Get note

get_pipeline_sensors.description: List the sensors runners in this workspace have registered — what pipeline_config.stages[*].sensors[*].name is validated against. Deduped union; the first runner to report a name wins.
get_pipeline_sensors.title: Get pipeline sensors

get_project_context.description:
Get a full board briefing in one call: board summary, definition, notes, git repos, recent activity. The recommended first call for any board workflow.

Board section is per-column counts only. Notes, definition, and activity are capped; a trimmed section carries a _..._truncated marker and a _hint naming the tool with the full data.
get_project_context.title: Get project context

get_server_info.description:
Report this server's version, full tool surface, and the hand enabled in
THIS session; call it when a tool seems missing (version, toolset or
allowlist drift).

Returns version, tools/tool_count (full live surface even when filtered;
deprecated_aliases lists retired names still callable until
deprecated_removed_in, allowlist_deprecated the granted ones),
allowlist, toolsets (loaded ids; resolved_tool_count = the toolset hand
BEFORE the allowlist intersection; default, available ids, hint to widen),
enabled_tools (registered ∩ toolsets ∩ allowlist; allowlist entries this
server lacks under allowlist_unknown, entries clipped by the loaded
toolsets under allowlist_outside_toolsets), listing_bytes/
listing_tokens_estimate (compact size of this session's tools/list;
tokens ≈ bytes/4), annotated_tools, backend reachability (GET /api/health).
get_server_info.title: Get server info

get_skill.description:
Fetch a skill version's files verbatim (with its declared toolsets).
Long files are truncated; re-fetch one whole with file_path.

params.file_path: Return this one file in full.
params.version: Omit for the latest published; pass explicitly for a draft.

get_skill.title: Get skill

get_team.description: Get one team with its members and their roles.
get_team.title: Get team

get_upload_url.description: Get a signed URL to PUT a file to, then register it with create_resource.
get_upload_url.title: Get upload url

get_webhook.description:
Read one webhook's URL, events, active state, and delivery health;
not-found under another workspace's slug.
get_webhook.title: Get webhook

get_workspace.description: Get a workspace's metadata (no member roster; see list_workspace_members).
get_workspace.title: Get workspace

get_workspace_config.description: Read the workspace config: pipeline_config, max_rework_attempts, card_cooldown_hours, commit/PR templates, model_pricing, cost_circuit_breaker, role_labels, version (bumps on every update).
get_workspace_config.title: Get workspace config

get_workspace_metrics.description: Workspace-wide delivery and spend figures in one read. velocity: cards completed over 7d/30d/90d; quality: reversion_rate (done cards that came back) and agent_efficiency_score — falling velocity with rising reversion means rework, not slowdown. cost: per-runner tokens/executions over 7d/30d and per-card total_cost_usd/tokens/execution_count — a card whose execution_count keeps climbing outside done is a money-loop. Do not re-derive totals. Per-board velocity is get_board_health; per-runner spend is get_agent_budget_status.
get_workspace_metrics.title: Get workspace metrics

get_workspace_summary.description: Get workspace aggregate stats: board/card/note/channel counts, recent activity, per-board board_stats (card_count, overdue_count, cards by column_type incl. untyped) and a 30-day activity_trend of {day, count} with zero-filled quiet days.
get_workspace_summary.title: Get workspace summary

import_loop_template.description:
Import a `loop_template` envelope as an unpublished DRAFT. Dry-run by
default: returns {action, findings, diff_summary, leak_findings}, writes
nothing; dry_run=false adds `template_id`. A matching slug overwrites
that draft (`action` updated|created). Over ~64 KB, POST
/loop-templates/import directly.
import_loop_template.title: Import loop template

import_pipeline_bundle.description:
Import a pipeline bundle into a workspace. DRY-RUN BY DEFAULT: inspect the preview, then re-call with dry_run=false. Requires admin/owner.

Checks: envelope (400), pipeline validation (422), expected_pipeline_version vs the target (409). Apply is atomic; re-import is idempotent.
import_pipeline_bundle.title: Import pipeline bundle

list_activity.description: Query a workspace's or board's activity log, newest first.

params.action: Activity action; see ENUMS in the server instructions.
params.entity_type: Activity entity_type; see ENUMS in the server instructions.

list_activity.title: List activity

list_agents.description: List the runners this user can administer.
list_agents.title: List agents

list_boards.description: List the boards in a workspace.
list_boards.title: List boards

list_card_dependencies.description: List a card's dependency edges both ways: depends_on (prerequisites) and blocks (dependents).
list_card_dependencies.title: List card dependencies

list_cards.description: List every card on a board, grouped by column.
list_cards.title: List cards

list_documentation.description: List product documentation from the connected platform, with its version and translation status.
list_documentation.title: List product documentation

list_executions.description:
List runner execution history for a workspace, newest first. Rows are
heavy (full input_prompt); keep limit small. Before cancel_execution on a
row, verify its agent_id/card_id match the scope you meant.

params.card_id: That card's history, ignoring limit, capped at the newest 200 rows.
params.status: started|running|completed|failed|aborted|skipped, or 'inflight' = all active rows workspace-wide, ignoring limit.

list_executions.title: List executions

list_git_repos.description: List the git repos linked to a board.
list_git_repos.title: List git repos

list_loop_template_versions.description: List a template's published versions, newest first: version, timestamp, note.
list_loop_template_versions.title: List loop template versions

params.q: Free-text filter over name and slug.

list_loop_templates.title: List loop templates

list_merge_queue.description:
List a workspace's in-flight merge-queue entries (queued, merging, conflict,
failed, blocked_pending_consolidation); merged ones only with merged_within_hours.

params.merged_within_hours: Also include entries merged within 1..720 hours.

list_merge_queue.title: List merge queue

list_notes.description: Browse a bounded page of notes; returns notes, total, has_more and next_offset.

params.card_id: Only notes linked to this card on this board (needs board_id).
params.kinds: Match any listed note kind (e.g. plan, review_verdict).
params.offset: Zero-based offset; follow next_offset with the same filters.
params.q: Case-insensitive substring search in title and plain-text body, before paging.
params.summary_only: Omit bodies by default; use get_note(format="markdown") to read one.
params.workspace_slug: Workspace slug (without board_id, workspace-level notes only).

list_notes.title: List notes

list_prompt_configs.description: List prompt configs, optionally filtered by team role.
list_prompt_configs.title: List prompt configs

list_resources.description: List resources in a workspace or board, with optional filters.
list_resources.title: List resources

list_skill_bindings_raw.description:
Raw view of a board's skill binding rows, disabled ones included;
list_skills(board_id) is the effective set callers actually get.
list_skill_bindings_raw.title: List skill bindings raw

list_skill_catalog.description:
List the built-in skill catalog: curated bundles (each declaring the
toolsets it plays in) not yet in the workspace library.
list_skill_catalog.title: List skill catalog

list_skills.description:
List workspace skills, or a board's effective skill set with board_id.
Metadata only (incl. each skill's declared toolsets and, for a board, the
toolsets its loop grant does not cover); get_skill returns the files.

params.board_id: Board UUID or slug: return its effective set.

list_skills.title: List skills

list_teams.description: List a workspace's teams with members and board assignments.
list_teams.title: List teams

params.is_active: true = active only, false = inactive only.

list_workspace_members.description: List workspace members (user_id, email, name, role); resolves people to user_id before adding card participants.
list_workspace_members.title: List workspace members

list_workspaces.description: List workspaces the caller can access; use the slug for workspace-scoped tools.
list_workspaces.title: List workspaces

log_execution_start.description: Log the start of a runner execution; returns execution_id for log_execution_update.

params.card_id: Card UUID if card-scoped; marks it actively worked.
params.input_summary: What the runner was asked to do.

log_execution_start.title: Log execution start

log_execution_update.description: Record an execution's status, result, or error at completion, failure, or a checkpoint.

params.ship_warnings: Non-fatal stage issues (amber chips); status stays as given.

log_execution_update.title: Log execution update

move_card.description: Move a card to another column and/or position. Omit position to append to the end of the target column.

params.position: Fractional index (midpoint between neighbours); omitted appends.

move_card.title: Move card

next_assignment.description:
Atomically reserve the next eligible card for a pipeline runner; role filters, untyped-column exclusion and role preconditions are applied server-side.

Returns card, board, column, repo, effective role, stage_action and a reservation (id + expires_at; auto-expires so a crashed runner cannot starve the board), or {"status": "no_work"} (sleep, retry). Idempotent while reserved; 409 = in-flight execution on another card (403 owner not a member, 404 unknown runner).

params.board_id: Restrict the scan to one board UUID.
params.role_override: A role the runner holds in its team, instead of its primary.

next_assignment.title: Next assignment

pause_agent.description:
Stop a runner from picking up new cards (idempotent); its in-flight card
still finishes, so use cancel_execution to end that too.
pause_agent.title: Pause agent

propose_skill.description:
Propose a new skill or version as a draft pending human approval;
nothing is served until approved. Idempotent: returns the pending proposal.

params.name: Omit to use SKILL.md frontmatter.
params.slug: Skill slug to create or version.

propose_skill.title: Propose skill

publish_loop_template.description:
Validate the draft, snapshot a new version and publish it; bound boards
show drift until re-rendered. Invalid draft: 422 with per-field findings.
publish_loop_template.title: Publish loop template

read_documentation.description: Read bounded Markdown from the connected platform's canonical product documentation.

params.offset: Character offset for continuing a section.
params.version: Version from list_documentation; mismatches fail explicitly.

read_documentation.title: Read product documentation

remove_card_dependency.description: Remove a depends-on edge. Idempotent: a missing edge is a no-op success.

params.card_id: Dependent card UUID or id prefix.
params.depends_on_card_id: Prerequisite card UUID or id prefix.

remove_card_dependency.title: Remove card dependency

remove_card_participant.description: Remove participants from a card: one person by user_id, or every holder of a pipeline_role (e.g. drop the stale implementer before rework; idempotent — a no-op when nobody holds it). Exactly one selector.

params.pipeline_role: Stage role to clear — planner, implementer, reviewer, rework_mediator or custom; instead of user_id.

remove_card_participant.title: Remove card participant

remove_skill_binding.description:
Delete a board's skill binding row, pin included; disable via
set_skill_binding to keep it. Idempotent.
remove_skill_binding.title: Remove skill binding

remove_team_member.description: Remove a runner from a team.
remove_team_member.title: Remove team member

remove_workspace_member.description: Remove a member from a workspace.
remove_workspace_member.title: Remove workspace member

reorder_columns.description: Reorder a board's columns. Send every column UUID on the board in the new left-to-right order; foreign ids are rejected and omitted columns keep their positions.

params.column_ids: All column UUIDs on the board, in order.

reorder_columns.title: Reorder columns

request_approval.description: Request human approval for a high-impact action, then poll get_approval_status.

params.action_payload: JSON of the action to run if approved.

request_approval.title: Request approval

request_landing.description: Request current-candidate queue landing under server policy, review, provenance and forge gates.
request_landing.title: Request landing

restart_agent.description:
Ask a live runner to finish its in-flight card and exit for its supervisor
to relaunch on fresh config; an offline runner returns 503.
restart_agent.title: Restart agent

restore_loop_template_version.description: Stage a published version as the current draft. Does not republish.
restore_loop_template_version.title: Restore loop template version

resume_agent.description: Re-enable card pickup for a paused runner (idempotent).
resume_agent.title: Resume agent

resume_cost_breaker.description:
Clear a tripped cost circuit breaker so runners can pick up work again — use when next_assignment returns 423 for every runner.

An acknowledgement, not a mute: the next spend over the threshold re-trips it. Threshold/action are unchanged (update_workspace_config). Admin/owner only. Returns {status: "resumed", workspace_id}.
resume_cost_breaker.title: Resume cost breaker

retry_completion.description: Retry a failed phase on the current immutable candidate. The runner produces review/validation results.
retry_completion.title: Retry completion

rotate_agent_key.description:
Mint a new API key for a runner; the old key dies immediately and
raw_api_key appears only in this result.
rotate_agent_key.title: Rotate agent key

search_cards.description:
Search and filter cards on a board by text, priority, type, status, label, assignee, column, column type, or overdue.

Use summary_only=True to browse or triage (full cards carry descriptions and participants and overflow on busy boards), then get_card for the one you need. Both modes include column_name and column_type.

params.has_assignee: True = has a hero, False = unassigned.
params.include_untyped: Include untyped (human-only) columns; default True. Pass False when picking work to execute.
params.label: Cards carrying this label.
params.overdue: True for cards past their due date.
params.q: Text to match in titles and descriptions.

search_cards.title: Search cards

set_board_loop.description: Edit loop config/state. Omitted fields persist; edits apply next iteration. Enable is idempotent, requiring nonempty loop_prompt. Config saves before state. When running in loop mode: call this with enabled=false and a concise reason when the objective is complete or you are blocked.

params.detach_template: Remove binding, retain rendered text; overrides template_ref.
params.loop_landing: Legacy human|self_merge|merge_queue. Human self_merge saves auto-relax the Done merge gate.
params.merge_gate: forge_ci (require green CI before queue merge)|none.
params.reason: Stop reason; saved only on enabled-to-disabled transition.
params.relax_done_merge_gate: False declines self_merge auto-relax for this save.
params.slot_values: Full replacement {SLOT_NAME:value}; alone re-renders the binding.
params.template_ref: System slug/workspace UUID to bind; owns prompts/tools (raw edits:422 alongside bind,409 later).

set_board_loop.title: Set board loop

set_skill_binding.description:
Upsert a skill binding on a board: enable/disable, optionally pin a
version. Omitted fields are unchanged (tri-state); new bindings default
to enabled, unpinned.

params.clear_pin: Remove the pin; exclusive with pinned_version.

set_skill_binding.title: Set skill binding

submit_completion_candidate.description: Submit execution provenance: a real open card PR, or exact evidence in operator-selected evidence-only mode.
submit_completion_candidate.title: Submit completion candidate

unfreeze_board.description:
Unfreeze a frozen board, reopening mutations and scheduling.

Workspace owner only (admins can freeze but not unfreeze). Idempotent.
unfreeze_board.title: Unfreeze board

update_agent.description: Update a runner's profile or constraints; only passed fields change. is_active=false is the reversible retirement; hard_delete=true erases the runner instead (API key, executions, approvals, team memberships — unrecoverable; 409 while a card is in flight) and accepts no other field.

params.hard_delete: True permanently erases the runner (unrecoverable); alone, with no other field.
params.name: New display name.

update_agent.title: Update agent

update_board.description:
Update a board's name, description, tags, or done-merge-gate override. Omitted fields are unchanged.

Human keys only (runners get 403). done_merge_gate needs workspace admin/owner.

params.done_merge_gate: inherit|enforced|off. Gates RUNNER moves into done on a merged PR with an approving verdict (humans never gated; no linked repo = exempt); inherit follows the workspace flag.
params.name: New display name.

update_board.title: Update board

update_card.description:
Update card fields; omitted or null values keep existing values.

To clear nullable values, pass clear_fields=["due_date"] (or another
supported field). Do not also set a non-null value for a cleared field.
Clear a description with description=""; clear labels with labels=[] or
clear_fields=["labels"] (JSON null). Repeating a clear is safe.

params.clear_fields: Nullable fields to set to null: due_date, status, labels, pr_url, branch_name, git_repo_slug. Omit to preserve existing values.
params.git_repo_slug: Target repo slug on multi-repo boards.
params.pr_url: PR the card shipped as; prefer it over a link in the description.
params.title: Max 500 characters.

update_card.title: Update card

update_channel.description: Update a channel; only provided fields change.

params.metadata_json: Shallow-merged per key; set a key to null to remove it.
params.name: New display name.

update_channel.title: Update channel

update_column.description: Update column fields; only provided fields change.

params.column_type: backlog|active|review|done|blocked, or "null" to clear the type and make the column human-only (runners skip it).
params.name: New display name.

update_column.title: Update column

update_definition.description:
Upsert a board's definition. Shallow merge: only given keys are replaced.
Explicit params win over the same key in `content`.

params.content: Raw dict for keys with no dedicated param.

update_definition.title: Update definition

update_git_repo.description: Update a linked git repo; only passed fields change.

params.integration_branch: Staging branch that git.base_ref="integration_branch" stages fork from; empty keeps default_branch.
params.name: New display name.
params.slug: New board-unique slug; changes which cards' git_repo_slug resolve here.

update_git_repo.title: Update git repo

params.expected_updated_at: Optimistic lock: `draft_updated_at` last read; 409 on conflict.
params.name: New display name.

update_loop_template.title: Update loop template

update_note.description: Update a note; only provided fields change. mode decides what content does to the body: "replace" (default) rewrites the whole body; "append" adds blocks at the end (additive — a retry appends twice); "section" rewrites the body under anchor_heading only (idempotent; the heading stays, empty content clears the section, a missing heading is 404 and a duplicate 409). Prefer append/section for logs, trackers and long pinned notes. title/pinned/card_id apply in every mode.

params.anchor_heading: mode="section" only: heading text without the leading # marks (trimmed, case-insensitive).
params.card_id: Card to link (must be on the note's board); omit to keep the current link.
params.content: Body as markdown (HTML, plain text or ProseMirror JSON also accepted); required for mode="append".
params.detach_card: Clear the card link; wins over card_id.
params.mode: "replace" (whole body), "append" (blocks at the end), or "section" (under anchor_heading).
params.title: New title.

update_note.title: Update note

update_prompt_config.description: Update a prompt config; omitted fields are unchanged.
update_prompt_config.title: Update prompt config

update_resource.description: Update a resource; only provided fields change.

params.metadata: Shallow-merged per key; only `tags` survives validation, and a tags array replaces the whole list.
params.name: New name.

update_resource.title: Update resource

update_team.description: Update a team; only passed fields change.
update_team.title: Update team

update_webhook.description: Update a webhook; only passed fields change. is_active=false pauses deliveries reversibly; delete=true removes the registration for good (deliveries stop at once; an already-deleted webhook reports so) and accepts no other field.

params.delete: True permanently removes the webhook (no undo); alone, with no other field. Prefer is_active=false to pause.
params.secret: New HMAC secret; update the receiver too.

update_webhook.title: Update webhook

update_workspace_config.description:
PATCH the workspace config; omitted fields stay unchanged. Requires admin/owner.

Not pre-validated: a malformed payload returns the backend validator's 422 error list as message. Pass {} to clear a dict field. Stage edits: read with get_workspace_config, mutate, send back the whole pipeline_config.

params.card_cooldown_hours: Wait before re-offering a released card.
params.pipeline_config: {"stages": [{role, discover, claim, git, llm, on_success}], "scheduling"?}; llm.context_sources[] = {"kind", "filter"?, "as"?} with kind card_notes|board_definition|pinned_notes|sibling_cards|board_snapshot|review_history.

update_workspace_config.title: Update workspace config

update_workspace_member.description: Change a workspace member's role. Same role is a no-op; granting or demoting owner needs an acting owner and a human caller (runner keys get 403 human_required).
update_workspace_member.title: Update workspace member

validate_board_dependencies.description: Check a board's whole dependency graph for faults. Read-only. ok=True when clean; otherwise cycles (mutually dependent cards, never eligible), conflicts (done cards with undone prerequisites) and orphans (edges pointing off-board), each with a summary.
validate_board_dependencies.title: Validate board dependencies

whoami.description: Identify the authenticated user behind this session (id, email, name).
whoami.title: Who am I
